title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1982-04-06
source: flac16/48kHz; Source Info: Jim Wise's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Bob Wagner's Sony TC-D5M > Jim's Sony TC-D5M (Maxell UDXLII-C90)Transfer Info:Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp (24-bit/96 kHz) > Adobe Audition 3.01 (24-bit/96 kHz) > TLH flac2496; 24-bit > 16-bit via dBpoweramp

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy early‑80s show captured on a lively audience cassette that delivers clear crowd‑rich sound.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the vibrant performance, noting a rock‑heavy first set and an over‑the‑top second set that captures the band’s late‑70s/early‑80s verve. The audience/master‑cassette source recorded by Jim Wise is praised for its clean transfer and strong crowd presence, making it a worthy alternative to the mediocre soundboard tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers give 5‑star ratings, highlighting an energetic show and a solid audience recording; the combination of strong musical performance and good technical quality warrants a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fresh cassette transfer with clear mix, good crowd energy capture; despite being an alternate source to the soundboard, the tape sounds clean and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set delivers nonstop rockers reminiscent of late‑70s shows; second set goes over the top with high energy, followed by a post‑space that maintains the vintage vibe.
